A '''Divine Favor''' is the rarest magic material in [[Matcha Flavoured]]. It replaces the {{MCW|Nether Star|nether star}}. A Divine Favor is worth nine [[Divine Fragment]]s and can be crafted to and from them. It is awarded for killing the {{MCW|Ender Dragon|Ender Dragon}} for the first time and for killing the [[Wither]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Ender Dragon ===
The first time each player kills the [[Ender Dragon]], a Divine Favor appears at the center of [[The End]], at height 100 above the exit portal. The item never despawns.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/first_dragon_killed_reward.mcfunction}}</ref> The reward comes from the player's "Iconoclast" advancement, so each player can earn it once, and the killing blow must come from a player.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/end/kill_dragon.json}}</ref> The same kill makes the surface safe from hostile mobs; see [[Surface]].

=== Wither ===
The [[Wither]] drops a Divine Favor, as it drops a nether star in vanilla. Withers can only be spawned on the surface of the Overworld (in view of the sky and at height 63 or above); one spawned anywhere else is removed at once, along with any Divine Favor it would leave.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/predicate/wither/invalid_wither_spawn.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/wither/forbid_wither.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

== Usage ==
{{Uses}}
Besides the {{MCW|Beacon|beacon}}, a Divine Favor is needed for the two strongest [[blessing]]s: the [[Prayer of Daedalus]] (Efficiency III and Unbreaking III) and the [[Prayer of Lu Ban]] (Mending). It can also be broken into 9 Divine Fragments.

== Behavior ==
A Divine Favor lying on the ground floats: it has no gravity, sinks slowly while the block three below it is air, and rises while the block directly below it is not air. It gives off white flash particles.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/particle/item_particle_nether_star_motion.mcfunction}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/timers/0_5/item_particles.mcfunction}}</ref>
